title: Current groups, Slow Drag, private jobs and the union
summary: He describes his trio and quartet after losing everything in a fire, private party and country club jobs, and union status as a guitarist.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

Yeah.

Basooka, guitar and banjo.
Yeah. Usually they don't use the string bass unless you have four of them.
